cost_source_quote: Free Job Training in Birmingham, AL
cost_notes: The page title reads 'Free Job Training in Birmingham, AL' which implies no cost to participants, but no section describing Career Path itself states a cost figure or confirms it applies to Career Path specifically as opposed to Fresh Start or Future Leaders.
Nothing on the page discusses when any payment, deposit, or fee would be due, which means there is no basis here to say whether funding assistance would even be relevant.

requirements.label: Must be an adult, age 18 or older

data_quality_flags.note: This page actually describes three separate programs at this site (Career Path, Fresh Start, Future Leaders) with different age ranges, eligibility, and outcomes. This registry entry only captures Career Path; a connector citing this entry must not apply its details to Fresh Start or Future Leaders, which have their own eligibility and credentials stated on the same page.

The 'Free' claim comes from the page title/tagline, not from the Career Path program description itself, so it is not certain this applies without exception to Career Path (materials, exams, or other fees are not addressed either way).
data_quality_flags.source_quote: Free Job Training in Birmingham, AL

data_quality_flags.note: No certification or credential is named for Career Path graduates. By contrast, the Fresh Start program on the same page explicitly names the OSHA-10 certification, which makes the absence of any named credential for Career Path notable rather than an oversight in this extraction.
The page never states whether Career Path classes are held online, in person, or hybrid.
Only a weekly info-session schedule is published (days and times to learn about the program), not actual class start dates, cohort length, or end dates for Career Path itself.
data_quality_flags.source_quote: CAREER PATH – Tuesdays and Thursdays at 11:00am

data_quality_flags.note: The page never gives a full legal entity name (e.g. an Inc./Corp suffix) for STRIVE, only the short name 'STRIVE'.

The only phone number and email published anywhere on the page belong to STRIVE's New York headquarters, not the Birmingham site. The Birmingham site's own listing has a mailing address but no local phone or email.

plain.the_job_is: That is help getting a first job in healthcare.
plain.what_you_get: You get classes, coaching, and job-readiness training aimed at a healthcare job, but the page does not say if you earn a certificate or what it costs beyond calling itself free.

translations.you_say: You take classes, get coached, and practice skills so you are ready to work.
